answer: Consensus flows like a river through web-of-trust staking, where trust dissipates outward like a cosmic nebula. Each validator stamps subjective reputation into the ledger; when an identity acts maliciously, the penalty casts an exponential slashing ripple across all endorsing peers. Sponsoring fraudulent identities imposes a superlinear cost curve on colluders, drowning synthetic swarms before they reach downstream quorum.
